text: Any Docker image implementing a three-endpoint contract can run as an agent, regardless of framework (CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, custom scripts)
quote: CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, your own Python script: any Docker image that speaks a three-endpoint contract gets the whole platform.

text: Agent provisioning is idempotent via an externalId tag, returning existing agent or creating a new one
quote: Tag each agent with your own id via `externalId`. `provision` is **idempotent** on it: it returns the existing agent if there is one, else creates a new one.

text: Subscribe a URL to receive signed JSON webhook notifications on agent lifecycle state changes
quote: Get notified when a customer's agent changes state, instead of polling. Subscribe a URL, and Maritime POSTs a signed JSON body on every lifecycle event.

text: Issue narrowly scoped API keys so a leaked key only grants limited permissions
quote: Hand a subsystem the narrowest key it needs. A leaked key can then only do what its scope allows.

text: Provision a persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) per end user, controllable by a model
quote: A persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) for each of _your_ end users, driven by _your_ model.

text: Live-stream an agent's build logs on its Overview page
quote: The agent page streams the build log live under **Overview → Builds**.

text: Templates are cloneable agent packages that publishers can share via link or a public library
quote: Templates are cloneable agent packages; publishers can share them via link or the public library.

text: Generate a personal API key via CLI and use it as a Bearer token, same as the CLI itself uses
quote: Mint a personal API key with `maritime keys create` and send it as a Bearer token, the same token the CLI itself uses.

text: Every CLI command supports a --json flag returning a single JSON value for scripting/automation
quote: Pass --json on EVERY command. Success: one JSON value on stdout, stderr empty.

text: Cron triggers using a standard five-field expression wake an agent on schedule and deliver a prompt as a chat message
quote: A cron trigger takes a standard five-field expression, wakes the agent on schedule, and delivers its `prompt` as a chat message on every fire.

text: Bulk-import environment variables from a .env file or stdin, then hot-reload them
quote: Bulk import from a .env file (or stdin), then hot-reload

text: An always-on add-on keeps an agent running continuously for low-latency, round-the-clock reaction
quote: Always-on is a flat add-on for the rare agent that must react in milliseconds around the clock.

text: Ready-made templates are pre-configured real agent frameworks deployable with one image pull
quote: Every ready-made template is a real agent framework, pre-configured and one image pull from live. Pick one, name it, deploy.

text: Deploy and start talking to your first agent in under 5 minutes
quote: Deploy your first agent and talk to it, in under 5 minutes.

text: Supports migrating existing workloads from AWS, Heroku, or a VPS
quote: Migrate from AWS, Heroku, or a VPS

text: Point Claude Code or a Maritime agent at a provider's runbook page to inventory and recreate old workloads as Maritime agents using read-only credentials
quote: point Claude Code or your Maritime agent at a provider's runbook page and it can inventory the old provider with read-only credentials, recreate each workload as a Maritime agent
